Plans.Filter: (ROW(created_at, workflow_name, workflow_id) < ROW('2026-09-30 17:08:00-07'::timestamp with time zone, 'wide'::text, ''::text))

sql: /* keiro-inspection-page-v2 */ WITH inspection_page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE true AND (created_at, workflow_name, workflow_id) < ($1,$2,$3) ORDER BY created_at DESC, workflow_name DESC, workflow_id DESC LIMIT $4) SELECT now(), inspection_page.* FROM (VALUES (1)) AS clock(x) LEFT JOIN inspection_page ON true ORDER BY created_at DESC, workflow_name DESC, workflow_id DESC
